parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.budget_target, p.location_address, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.urgency, c.name as client_name, c.email as client_email, (SELECT row_to_json(b.*) FROM briefings b WHERE b.project_id = p.id AND b.status = 'approved' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as briefing, (SELECT row_to_json(d.*) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1) as design_option, (SELECT row_to_json(ce.*) FROM cost_estimates ce WHERE ce.project_id = p.id ORDER BY ce.version DESC LIMIT 1) as cost_estimate, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('trade_type', tr.trade_type, 'scope_description', tr.scope_description) ORDER BY tr.trade_type) FROM trade_requests tr WHERE tr.project_id = p.id AND tr.status = 'prepared') as trade_assignments FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_planner', 'running', NOW()) RETURNING id
INSERT INTO project_plans (project_id, total_duration_days, phases, milestones, critical_path, notes, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6, 'draft') RETURNING id
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO project_intelligence (project_id, agent_name, key, value) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_planner', 'plan_generated', $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (project_id, agent_name, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()
